name: anew
description: Free webpages: websites that live in the URL. Encode a self-contained HTML document into a shareable anew.page URL, and read the HTML back out of one. No account, no hosting, no deploy step.

interface.shortDescription: Websites that live in the URL.
interface.longDescription:
Free webpages: websites that live in the URL. anew encodes a complete, self-contained HTML document into a shareable URL. The page is compressed into the link itself, so there is no account, no database, and no deploy step — you get a URL back immediately, and anyone who opens it sees the page.

Because the URL is the page, reading one back gives you its exact HTML. That makes editing a round trip: read the link, change the markup, write it again. Every write mints a new URL and leaves the original working, so a link you have already shared never breaks.

Two tools. anew_write takes one self-contained HTML document and returns its URL, along with the page's size, with the share warning when one applies. anew_read takes an anew.page URL and returns the HTML encoded in it.

Nothing is stored server-side. There is no page to delete, no account to manage, and no authentication to set up — connect the endpoint and it works.
capabilities: Publish a page as a URL
Read a page back to its HTML
defaultPrompt: Make me a one-page résumé from this text and give me the link.
Take the page at this anew.page URL, change the heading colour to red, and send me the new link.
Build a small interactive tip calculator as a page I can share with my team.

positive.prompt: Create a self-contained anew.page with the heading "Hello from anew" and one short paragraph, then give me its shareable link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the minted anew.page URL verbatim with its byte measurements; the page shows the requested heading and paragraph.

positive.prompt: Build a self-contained interactive tip calculator with inline CSS and JavaScript, then give me an anew.page link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a working anew.page URL with byte measurements; the page contains the requested interactive calculator without required external assets.

positive.description: Read exact author HTML from a full anew.page URL.
positive.prompt: Read the exact author HTML encoded in https://anew.page/PGgxPmEgbmV3IGludGVybmV0IHN0YXJ0cyB3aXRoIGFuZXcucGFnZTwvaDE- and return the source, not the rendered DOM.
positive.expected_behavior:
Returns exactly

a new internet starts with anew.page

together with the canonical URL and byte metadata.

positive.description: Read a bare slug as a typed HTML resource.
positive.prompt: Decode the bare anew slug PGgxPmEgbmV3IGludGVybmV0IHN0YXJ0cyB3aXRoIGFuZXcucGFnZTwvaDE- and return it as an HTML resource.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one text/html embedded resource containing the exact heading HTML, plus the canonical URL and byte metadata.

positive.description: Round-trip an edit without overwriting the original page.
positive.prompt: Read https://anew.page/PGgxPmEgbmV3IGludGVybmV0IHN0YXJ0cyB3aXRoIGFuZXcucGFnZTwvaDE-, change the heading to "Revised with anew", and return a new anew.page link.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the exact original HTML, returns a new working URL containing the revised heading, and leaves the original URL unchanged.

negative.description: Do not trigger for deletion requests.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete this anew.page URL so nobody can open it again.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because anew provides no deletion capability.

negative.description: Do not trigger for page discovery or history requests.
negative.prompt: List everything someone else has published on anew.page this week.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because anew has no page index, account history, or search workflow.

negative.description: Do not trigger for arbitrary website reading.
negative.prompt: Fetch the HTML source of https://example.com and summarize it.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because anew_read only decodes HTML carried by anew.page URLs or slugs and does not fetch arbitrary sites.

review.commerce_description: anew sells nothing and processes no payments. Both tools work without an account.

publication.release_notes: The listing, starter prompts and review cases now ship in the manifest under extensions.com.openai. The two tools are unchanged.
